def count_rotation(arr):
    """
    Count the number of rotations in a sorted array that has been rotated.
    Returns the index of the minimum element measured from the end,
    i.e. len(arr) minus the index of the smallest value.
    """
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    lo, hi = 0, n - 1
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if arr[mid] > arr[hi]:
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            hi = mid
    return n - lo


assert count_rotation([3, 2, 1]) == 1
